features.text: Restores the thigh strap on your Ossur Unloader Hip when the original wears out.

features.label: Exact brace match
features.text: Designed to perfectly match the sizing of your existing brace.

features.label: Easy installation
features.text: Simple to thread through the original routing and secure to closure points.

measurement: Measure hip circumference at the anterior superior iliac spine (front hip bone). Match the kit size to the size of the Unloader Hip brace you already own. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
